notes.title: Kairos 1.0.0 Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645021/79e055dd2927b3f0508e742a1c170e21894b2142.jpg[/img]
[h1]Kairos is out now and free to play!!![/h1]
[h2]So, what is Kairos? [/h2]
Kairos is a Real-Time Strategy base building game set in a medieval fantasy world consumed by an ancient Corruption. As the last bastion of life, you must fortify your defenses by creating armies and building structures to fight the endless corrupted onslaught. As the Corruption spreads across the land, the player will deploy Purifiers to cleanse the world and take back their home from the evil corruption. 

[h2]Kairos 1.0.0 Changelog[/h2]
Changes
[list]
[*] Archer towers have been made smaller and shoot faster
[*] Production and Structure UI has been updated
[*] Added Unit Icons 
[*] Added Well as an occasional decoration 
[*] The world will now generate destroyed corrupted structures which the player can capture with a builder
[*] Collector unit will highlight the resource it is collecting from and the stronghold it drops them off at when selected
[*] Press 'o' to move camera to nearest builder
[*] Press 'p' to move camera to nearest collector
[*] Settings menu is enabled and allows for setting resolution and choosing Fullscreen setup
[*] MiniMap added to game
[*] Press 'm' to hide the MiniMap
[/list]

	


Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Resource Collectors now release nodes on death
[/list]

notes.title: Kairos 0.3.0
notes.content:
Changelog
Tutorial 
- A new menu allows you to enter the tutorial when starting a new game.
- The tutorial describes to users how to play the game without the corruption spread being turned on. This should help new users with getting started. 
 
Changes
- Unit Queue can now be seen
- Units can now be removed from the queue.
- Structures and Units now have resource costs.
- Map Reload now occurs all at once
- Exit confirmation added to the pause menu
 
Bug Fixes
- Unit commands can no longer be done through the UI
- You can no longer destroy enemy nodes
- Destroy button now only appears when a structure is selected
- Corruption should no longer spread when paused
- Fixed frame drops when updating map

notes.title: Kairos Patch 0.2.2
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
	- Corruption can now damage units and structures
	- Health bars show on damaged units
	- Shift + click button to train 5 units at a times
	- Removed box-select units
	- Added structure delete button

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
	- Archer tower no longer purifies the corruption
	- Builders no longer freak out…
	- Clicking on items with a menu no longer fails when moving from one to another
	- Any builder can now continue 
	- Fixed Menu Building Clickthrough
	- Fixed box select menu clickthrough
	- Fixed UI Button Text size
	- Fixed defeat parameters
        - Fixed main menu sizing issue

notes.title: Kairos Patch 0.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]Purification[/h3]
	- You can now build the purification tower
	- Purification towers will push back the corruption keeping it from growing

[h3]Other[/h3]
	- Added arrows to Archers
	- Added arrows to Archer Towers
	- Added rally point flags

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
        - Build now path finds with other units
	- Fixed scene lighting issues
	- Fixed world not randomly generating
        - Enemies now target other structures and units

notes.title: Kairos 0.2.0 is Out!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43645021/79e055dd2927b3f0508e742a1c170e21894b2142.jpg[/img]
[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h3]Corruption[/h3]
	- Corruption now effects the tiles of the world
	- Corruption will slowly spread across the world
	- Corrupted Nodes will spawn only in corrupted areas
	- Enemies now attack the stronghold

[h3]Crystal Resource[/h3]
	- Player can now train resource collectors to collect resources
	**Resources are not used for anything yet**
	

[h3]World Generation[/h3]
	- Updated terrain generation settings
	- Added corruption generation
	- Added tree decoration spawning
	- Generator now places corruption nodes automatically
	- Generator now places stronghold automatically
	- Stronghold clears nearby corruption upon world creation
	- Added corrupted tree variants
	- Added Crystal Resource Spawning

[h3]New Units[/h3]
	- Archer - A simple long ranged attacking unit
	- Builder - Can construct secondary strongholds for spawning more units
	- Resource Collector - Collects from resource nodes (Resources are currently useless)

[h3]New Structures[/h3]
	- Archer Tower - Tower that attacks units who come near it
	- Purifier - Can purify nearby corrupted towers
	- Barracks - Allows for training of units
	
[h3]New Decorations[/h3]
	- Added Tree that spawns in the world (Does not have any interaction)
	- Added Corrupted Tree variant 

[h3]New Models[/h3]
	- Added model to archer
	- Added model to builder
	- Added model to corruption node
	- Added model to Stronghold

[h3]User Interface[/h3]
	- Swapped to the new Unity UI Toolkit system
	- Updated Some menus - More to come

[h3]Updated Camera Movement[/h3]

[h3]Added Mac Compatibility[/h3]
